items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: A guy by the name of Harry James brought them up here, not the trumpet players.

ctx.x: Yellow Nunes came up with the original band, and they played on the Red Lantern. A guy by the name of Harry James brought them up here, not the trumpet players. Yes, yeah.
He's still living, I think, in the audience. Yeah.
